description: Keep Renovate's PR count low and readable, for every e-llabo repository (inherited org-wide through e-llabo/renovate-config): one weekly PR per repo for all non-major updates, one PR per repo for all major updates, opened as soon as they are found, at most 3 open Renovate PRs per repo. Security fixes are not grouped and not scheduled (Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults).

packageRules.description: Every minor, patch, digest and pin update in ONE weekly PR per repository.
Every major update as its OWN PR (developer decision 2026-09-25), opened at the next run rather than on the weekly schedule. Minor, patch and digest updates stay grouped in one weekly PR.
